title: Station-aware P-to-S ground-motion estimation with linear mixed-effects models: code and fitted models
description: Code, fitted linear mixed-effects models (OLS and Models 1-5), station-specific coefficients for 297 GeoNet strong-motion stations, and the derived record-level feature table for the SRL article 'A Mixed-Effects Modeling Approach for Station-Aware P-to-S Ground-Motion Estimation in Earthquake Early Warning'.
